title: Klinik Clowns – Lachen hilft
lead: Specially trained artists who visit hospitals and care homes. A film about humour, sensitivity and the human connection they create.
text: The film follows hospital clowns from preparation to the visit itself, navigating the contrast between institutional routines and moments of warmth, playfulness and vulnerability.
A restrained, observational perspective alternates with composed passages: central perspective, ambient sound and close-ups that foreground exchange and emotion.
The treatment set two modes against each other: a restrained, observational camera for the routines of the clinic, and composed passages for the moments of exchange.
Central perspective, ambient sound and close-ups: the notebook gathers the references for both, from the preparation backstage to the visit itself.
